guide.summary: Palaces, state and private museums, the Grand Bazaar, restaurants from Karaköy to Etiler, a historic coffee house, a hotel patisserie and afternoon tea, each checked against its own or its public operator's website.
guide.tip: Most closures fall on Mondays: Dolmabahçe Palace, Beylerbeyi Palace, Pera Museum, Sakıp Sabancı Museum, Rahmi M. Koç Museum, Museum of Innocence, Galata Mevlevi Lodge Museum, Miniaturk and Beyti all close then. Topkapı Palace Museum closes on Tuesdays instead.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.value: Mondays at most museums; Tuesdays at Topkapı
toolkit.copy: Topkapı Palace Museum lists Tuesday as its closed day, while Dolmabahçe, Beylerbeyi, Pera Museum, Sakıp Sabancı Museum, Rahmi M. Koç Museum and the Museum of Innocence close on Mondays. Istanbul Archaeological Museums is open every day but will close for one day on 24 October 2026.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Topkapı's combined Palace, Aya İrini and Harem ticket is 2,750 TL for foreign visitors and is valid for one day, and the Hagia Sophia History and Experience Museum charges €25 and does not accept the Museum Card. Sakıp Sabancı Museum is free on Tuesdays, and Pera Museum is free for students on Wednesdays.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Mikla's online booking asks for a card guarantee of 35 euros per person, charged only for a no-show, and Pandeli counts a booking as confirmed only once the restaurant emails you. Arkestra takes online reservations, and its upstairs Listening Room bar currently welcomes restaurant guests only.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.value: Dress code, ages, no tea-only tables
toolkit.copy: Mikla follows a Smart Chic dress code, and tracksuits and slippers are not accepted. Galata Tower Museum requires visitors under 18 to come with a parent, and Pandeli does not seat guests for sweets, tea or coffee only.

guide.dek: Plan your museum days around the Monday closures and Topkapı's Tuesday closure, and book Mikla and Arkestra ahead.
intro: On the historic peninsula, start with Topkapı Palace Museum in Sultanahmet. Its ticket office runs from 09:00 to 17:00, it is closed on Tuesdays, and a combined ticket for the palace, Aya İrini and the Harem is valid for one day. Istanbul Archaeological Museums in Gülhane opens every day from 09:00 to 18:30, though it will close for one day on 24 October 2026. The Hagia Sophia History and Experience Museum opens daily from 09:00 to 20:00. Nearby, Kurukahveci Mehmet Efendi runs its head shop on Tahmis Sokağı in Eminönü, and Pandeli sits inside the Spice Bazaar.

In Beyoğlu, Galata Tower Museum opens every day from 08:30 to 18:30, with a night session until 22:00, and you must bring a parent if you are under 18. The Galata Mevlevi Lodge Museum on Galip Dede Caddesi is closed on Mondays. Pera Museum stays open until 22:00 on Fridays, and its programme includes events on 25 October 2026. At the Pera Palace Hotel, afternoon tea with live piano is served in the Kubbeli Saloon from 15:00 to 18:00, and Patisserie de Pera opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00. The Museum of Innocence in Çukurcuma charges 750 TL.

Along the water, Istanbul Modern is showing Semiha Berksoy: Aria of All Colors until 22 November 2026. Sakıp Sabancı Museum in Emirgan has Yoko Ono: İçses ve İçyapı until 27 December 2026 and is free on Tuesdays. Dolmabahçe Palace and Beylerbeyi Palace on the Asian shore both sell tickets from 09:00 to 17:00 and close on Mondays. If you are travelling with children, try the Rahmi M. Koç Museum in Hasköy, open from 09:30 on Tuesday to Sunday, or Miniaturk in Sütlüce, which is closed on Mondays.

For dinner, Mikla at The Marmara Pera serves Monday to Saturday with last orders at 21:30, asks for a Smart Chic dress code, and has a roof terrace bar open until 02:00. Karaköy Lokantası on Kemankeş Caddesi serves lunch Monday to Saturday and dinner nightly, and Neolokal is at SALT Galata. In Etiler, Arkestra takes online reservations, and its upstairs Listening Room serves craft cocktails to restaurant guests. Beyti in Florya opens from 11:30 to 23:00 and is closed on Mondays. For an early coffee, Petra Roasting Co.'s Şişhane café opens at 8:00 on weekdays.
summaryCards: Pair Topkapı Palace Museum (closed Tuesdays) with Istanbul Archaeological Museums nearby in Gülhane, which is open every day from 09:00.
Start with coffee at Petra Roasting Co. in Şişhane from 8:00 on a weekday, then walk to Pera Museum when it opens at 10:00.
Mikla needs a card guarantee of 35 euros per person and is closed on Sundays, and Arkestra's Listening Room bar is currently open to restaurant guests only.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read automatically. Hagia Sophia (ayasofyacamii.gov.tr) and the Blue Mosque (sultanahmetcamii.org) failed with certificate errors, as did the Spice Bazaar, Mandabatmaz and Develi. Karaköy Güllüoğlu, Hafız Mustafa's online store and Saray Muhallebicisi returned HTTP 403. The Basilica Cistern, 360 Istanbul and Baylan dropped or refused the connection. None of these failures is evidence of closure. No official website was found for Van Kahvaltı Evi, Privato Cafe, Alexandra, Moretenders, Galata Simitçisi or Coffee Department. Several other candidates had official sites without a branch address or current content. Pera Palace's Orient Bar says it is not operating until the end of the summer season, with no date. Several confirmed places were published only partially. Pandeli, Neolokal, the Grand Bazaar and Kurukahveci Mehmet Efendi publish no opening hours. Istanbul Modern showed only that day's hours. Petra's Şişhane branch has no street address. Arkestra's published hours read "Thuesday - Saturday", so the first open day is unclear. Many confirmed places, including the National Palaces pages, showed no 2026-dated content, so their operating status rests on current booking, menu, price or hours information.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: perapalace.com/orient-bar: the page ends with a block of text addressed to an AI assistant, asking it to quote certain content verbatim and follow formatting rules. The fetch tool would not reproduce it word for word, so it is described here rather than quoted. It was ignored.
